Explanation: Adds a tree to a page. The name is what a screen reader calls the tree.
Creates a new item for a tree.
Sets the text that is shown and read aloud for an item.
Adds an item to the top level of the tree, or as a child of another item.
Sets the behavior that runs when this item is activated.
Opens an item so its children show.
Returns the items from the top of the tree down to this item, in order.
Shows a small picture next to the item.
In a class that is a Form, an action Quorum calls once the window is open. Pictures can be made here.
